method: Surface-specific full-read adjudication for ACATQ-0041/ACABC-0042: extend an existing Tier A persistence test family before source work, write read-adjudicated persistence/ledger records from cited active evidence, run targeted tests and validation, and leave source unchanged because the extension passed.

records.title: ReceiptLedger is the bounded audit/checkpoint receipt ledger primitive
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: ReceiptLedger appends JSON-serialisable receipt payloads by normalised id/kind, rejects duplicate ids and empty tokens, and returns defensive copies on read/list surfaces.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: Existing Tier A receipt-ledger family was read-adjudicated; no source repair was opened for receipt-kind allowlisting because kind ownership beyond audit/checkpoint receipts crosses other read surfaces.
adjudication_notes: This record covers the active receipt-ledger primitive, not every downstream receipt producer.
The structural inventory and Bridge row were used only to navigate to this surface.
limitations: This is static structural evidence only. It does not prove semantic correctness, native satisfaction, implementation maturity, or test pass status.
Receipt-kind policy is not sealed here; downstream live-inventory receipt use was observed but not fully adjudicated in this pass.

records.title: Identifier-keyed position and capital repositories reject duplicate durable ids
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: PositionRepository and CapitalStateRepository store one snapshot per normalised id, reject duplicate ids, preserve insertion order through list surfaces, and return defensive copies for reads/lists.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: Existing duplicate-id/copy-boundary Tier A tests already cover the durable-id overwrite hazard for these repositories; no source repair was opened.
adjudication_notes: This is repository-surface evidence only; it does not claim financial/capital decision-policy correctness.
limitations: This is static structural evidence only. It does not prove semantic correctness, native satisfaction, implementation maturity, or test pass status.

records.title: Append-only observation and event repositories expose append/list surfaces without keyed mutators
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: Append-only observation/event/research-log repositories copy inputs, preserve append order, return copies on list/read surfaces, and the extended Tier A family now rejects public keyed overwrite/update/delete/upsert/write methods on the execution-event and market-observation append-only stores.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: Extended an already-admitted Tier A persistence family before source work with a public-mutator absence test. Existing source passed; no repair was opened.
adjudication_notes: This pass deliberately stayed on the existing append-only family because ACATQ-0041 required extension, not a new test family.
limitations: This is static structural evidence only. It does not prove semantic correctness, native satisfaction, implementation maturity, or test pass status.

records.test_first_gap_or_action: Existing Tier A store-surface tests already cover duplicate-id, write-only, and detached-receipt boundaries; no source repair was opened.
